Please try these steps now:
1) Wait 30–60 minutes and refresh the app (pending often clears automatically).
2) If you still need cash, try another ATM and don’t reuse the same attempt repeatedly.
3) Confirm your card is enabled for cash withdrawals and check for any withdrawal limits in the app.

Do you also see the pending withdrawal amount for the ATM transaction in the app (and has it been pending more than an hour)?
